title: China’s Export Engine Meets Europe’s Carbon Rules
gist: EU rules that will tax carbon-intensive steel and aluminum imports and block batteries exceeding carbon limits are reshaping Chinese industry, with Beijing launching zero-carbon industrial parks that hard-wire factories to renewable supply. Gavekal argues the second-order payoff is an export business: the industrial microgrid designs proven in those parks could be sold into emerging markets plagued by outages and poor power management.
